english.note: This is the all-purpose conversational choice for saying that something is tiny.
This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for saying that something is very small.

examples.english: My room is microscopic; after putting in a bed, there is no space left.
examples.traditional: 我間房好細，擺張床之後就冇位喇。
